Berkshire Hathaway Position In Apple (AAPL) Was Raised; Credit Suisse Group (CS) Holding Raised by Advisory Services Network Llc 
April 20, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson 
Warren Buffett increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 23.3% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Berkshire Hathaway Inc bought 31.24 million shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund run by Warren Buffett held 165.33 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $27.98 billion, up from 134.09M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Berkshire Hathaway Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $876.79B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.83% or $5.04 during the last trading session, reaching $172.8. About 31.52 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Advisory Services Network Llc increased its stake in Credit Suisse Group (CS) by 2513.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Advisory Services Network Llc bought 26,794 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.85% with the market. The institutional investor held 27,860 shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $497,000, up from 1,066 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Advisory Services Network Llc who had been investing in Credit Suisse Group for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $42.91B market cap company. The stock increased 0.91% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $16.59. About 1.75M shares traded. Credit Suisse Group AG (NYSE:CS) has risen 14.88% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.33% the S&P500.

(NASDAQ:AAPL) earned “Market Perform” rating by Cowen & Co on Tuesday, December 22. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, July 27 by Needham. The company was maintained on Friday, November 3 by UBS. As per Friday, July 21, the company rating was maintained by Mizuho. Zacks downgraded the shares of AAPL in report on Monday, August 17 to “Buy” rating. BMO Capital Markets maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Wednesday, August 2. BMO Capital Markets has “Outperform” rating and $180 target. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Friday, September 11 by BMO Capital Markets. The firm has “Buy” rating by Rosenblatt given on Friday, September 11. The stock has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Tuesday, February 21.
